caption:
133,371 people rated these blackout curtains before you even looked at them.

A window with weak curtains lets in every streetlight and sunrise. These are 42 inches wide by 63 inches long, sold as a 2-panel set in black, built specifically to block that light out.

The product blocks outside light by design, and a 4.6-star average across 133,371 reviews is not a number small batches of buyers produce — it reflects a huge, sustained customer base rating the same result consistently.

For a bedroom window that size, you get a rated blackout solution most people are satisfied with, at $9.98.
